# Spec lock
## Rules
- Canonical sidecar: persisted spec directory/spec-lock.json, valid JSON.
- schema.name/version required; immutable except explicit guarded reassignment. Reassign validates target artifacts; preserves implementation/optimizations; preserves dependencies without target extraction, otherwise requires extracted dependencies equal current. Same schema no-op.
- dependsOn stores canonical persisted IDs; authoritative source for metadata projection, including schemas without extraction.
- implementation entries need workspace:path file within spec workspace/codeRoot; optional non-empty symbols means symbol-level, absent means file-level. Use normalized forward slashes.
- Optional optimizations fields optimizedDescription/optimizedContext each store value, captured schema, artifactState filename -> hash/lastModified. Fields baseline independently; setting/clearing one leaves other intact; omit optimizations when empty.
- Optimization baseline becomes stale after reassignment; do not clear/regenerate it. Never synthesize optimization state from metadata.
- Lock-less specs valid; ordinary reads never create lock. Creation only archive, explicit initialization, or create-worthy persisted mutation. Initialization only once, derives dependencies from artifacts/schema, implementation [], no optimizations. Lock-less semantic no-op mutation does not create state.
- Writers: archive, explicit dependency/implementation/optimization/schema mutation, initialization, integrity maintenance. Use shared pure whole-document construction and conditional revision write.
- Archive validates raw implementation paths belong to spec workspace; excludes graph.excludePaths, discards unnormalizable, fails confirmed path outside codeRoot.
- Sidecar durable source for implementation and optimizations. metadata.json projection cannot invent/mutate/delete them; projects optimized field only when baseline fresh against artifacts/schema.
- SpecRepository.persistedStateMeta(spec, { includeHash: true })?.hash returns SHA-256 sidecar bytes; callers never read sidecar. Spec.get().persistedStateStamp exposes presence/lastModified; no separate persistedStateHash port method.
## Constraints
- schema never replaced by non-reassignment writer.
- Preserve file-level and symbol-level implementation links distinctly.
- Concurrent writers cannot silently overwrite.
